name: Team Group Inc.
summary: Team Group Inc. manufactures and trades integrated circuit chips, memory, and computer peripheral equipment in Taiwan, Asia, America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers desktop, laptop, and workstation memory; 2.5 inches, external/portable, and M.2 SSD cards, as well as enclosure kit; SD, MicroSD, CFexpress memory cards, and memory card readers; USB drives; and peripherals, such as case, fan, CPU cooler, SSD cooler, and accessories. It also sells electronic products and components. Team Group Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
